title: Lazy map, filter, take and sum over an async iterable
summary: Push the values of an async generator through a lazy async map, filter and take chain, sum what comes out, and report how far the source was read.
notes: An asynchronous task on one thread: each operation is one awaited call that pulls values one at a time through a chain of async iterators. The source yields without awaiting anything else and the callbacks are trivial, so the figures are the cost of the package's async combinators and of the runtime's promise and microtask machinery per value. No timer or sleep with a real delay is involved. Python runs on one asyncio loop.
